idea-plugin.name: AI Git Commit
idea-plugin.description:
Generate AI-powered Git commit messages directly from the Commit tool window.

AI Git Commit builds focused context from the files and partial changes you select, then sends it to the AI service and model you configure.

Highlights

  • Generate messages from selected changes, partial commit hunks, and unversioned files.
  • Choose the output language and use editable model IDs.
  • Create reusable custom prompts or load commit-prompt.txt from the project root.
  • Compact large change sets and exclude generated files, lock files, or custom wildcard patterns.
  • Use the IDE system proxy, inspect the latest prompt, and stream responses where supported.

Supported AI Services

OrcaRouter, Google Gemini, DeepSeek, OpenAI API, OpenAI-compatible providers, OpenRouter, Ollama, Alibaba Cloud Model Studio, SiliconFlow, VolcEngine, Cloudflare Workers AI, and Kimi.

Getting Started

  1. Open Settings/Preferences > Tools > AI Git Commit.
  2. Select a provider, model, and output language, then configure the endpoint and API key if required.
  3. Select changes in the Commit tool window and choose Generate AI Commit Message.

Privacy: Generating a message sends the selected change context and prompt to the AI service you configured. Review that provider's privacy and data-retention policies before sending sensitive source code.
